warnings: Grid bubbles are printed: 1-19 along x (18 bays x 4.00 = 72.00, total printed on S-17) and D, C, B, A along y from the top of the plan as drawn (D-C 2.50, C-B 5.50, B-A 2.50, total 10.50). Origin D1 (top-left as drawn) per spec section 4, same top-down lettering as houses 01-05.

Two eave dimensions 0.05 apart on the y axis: the structural roof-frame plan S-17 prints 2.05 from D/A to the roof edge, the architectural section A-12 prints 2.00 from the column line to the eave. Kept as two lines (D''/D''' and A''/A''') per section 4 rule 4 ('within 0.05 m ... keep both and say so'); the structural 2.05 is the one the roof framing sits on.

Levels: the set prints only spot levels (+0.00 ground, +0.30 fill, +0.45 walkway, +0.55 toilet, +0.60 floor) and the A-12 storey chain (3.85 / 3.50 / ~2.76). Absolute levels of ระเบียง (4.45), คานอะเส (7.95), สันโครงเหล็ก (10.71) and the stair landing (3.05) are sums of printed values, flagged as derived.

C-B gap (stair bays and classroom framing): the classroom floor beams (G1 floor 1, B4 floor 2) sit at the thirds of D-B, which no sheet dimensions — C' 2.67 / C'' 5.33 are scaled (measured 2.66 / 5.33 on both plans), flagged.

Stair beams: S-12 and S-13 both put the ground-floor stair beam G3 1.93-1.94 from row B (S-12 read with the A side on the left: G5 | G1 at B | G3 | G4 at C | G2 at D — the first version of this file measured it from C, corrected). The plan S-04 draws G3 at ~6.37 (not to scale). Kept as C'''' 6.06 (S-13 '~1.94') and C''''' 6.07 (S-12 'ประมาณ 1.93m'), the same physical line printed twice.

Floor-2 stair-top beam: S-12 prints 2.55 from B (5.45, C''') with 2.55 + 2.95 = 5.50 closing on C, and calls it B3; the plan S-05 labels it B1 and draws it in line with the B4s at 5.33; S-15 prints 'B1/B4' at ~1.94 from B6's end (6.06). The printed, self-consistent S-12 chain is used for the position (5.45), the plan's mark for the member (B1).
x 73.50 (19') is printed on S-04/S-05 ('4.00 | 1.50'); the S-17/S-06 eave at 74.00 is therefore 19'' (renamed house-wide, every reference checked).
S-06 (RC roof beams) prints the eave at 2.00 on both axes, S-17 (steel roof) at 2.05 on y and 2.00 on x; both y values are lines (D''' / D'' and A'' / A''').

Sweep status: every structural plan S-02..S-06 and S-17 is swept, plus the dimension rows of A-09 (left part), A-12 (section 1-1), A-21/A-22 (levels), S-12 (stair), S-13/S-15 (beam elevations). Not swept (op04 scope): the other architectural sheets A-10..A-24, the PT prefabricated-roof alternative (PT-01..PT-10) and the EE/F sheets. Element-internal dimensions of S-07..S-19 (section sizes, truss panels, footing plan sizes) stay on their elements, not here.

op04 dimension sweep 2026-10-23, batch 1 (A-09 page 09 completed, A-10 page 10, A-11 page 11, A-13 page 13, A-14 page 14): chains 4 and 5 (A-09) were only read to grid 6 / row A in the first run; their segments now carry the whole printed rows (2.00 | 1.50 | 4.00 x 18 | 1.50 | 2.00 and 2.00 | 1.50 | 2.50 | 5.50 | 2.50 | 1.50 | 2.00) (their view text was updated to say so). The A-09 x row ends 2.00 past 19' (73.50) at 75.50: a new dummy line (19''').

A-10, A-11, A-13 and A-14 add no other line: every tick lands on an existing line, including the deliberate eave pair (A-11/A-13/A-14 print the 2.00 eave -> D'''/A''; S-17's 2.05 lines D''/A''' untouched). A-10, A-13 and A-14 print no row bubbles: A-10 is read with D at the top like A-09; section 2-2 is read with A on the right (its 1.50 + 0.50 end matches the S-04 stair-bay walkway A'->A''), section 3-3 with A on the left (its 2.50 corridor bay is B-A). The reversed readings also land on existing lines, so line positions do not depend on these calls -- only the from/to names in the transcript do.

A-13 adds one unlabelled level, +6.20 (1.75 above floor 2 and 3.15 above the stair landing, both printed); A-13 labels the 7.95 level คานหลังคา / หลังคานหลังคา where A-12/A-14 print คานอะเส (same level, one entry).

op04 dimension sweep batch 2 (A-15 .. A-24, pages 15-24): A-15 (front/back elevations) and A-16 (side elevations) print no dimension row, no grid bubble and no level value. A-17 .. A-24 are 1:20 - 1:50 detail sheets (sanitary, toilet + stair, windows, doors, AL1/AL2, railing, RC stair) with no grid bubbles: their numbers are element-internal and went to unassigned_dimensions, one entry per sheet (the door/window sizes also sit on the schedule elements of pages 19-22). Decision (att1235): no new line from these sheets even where a row matches the grid (A-18 section A 2.50 | 1.50, A-21 2.00) -- without a printed bubble the anchor is an inference. Risk: those rows are not position-checked by gridfix.

A-18 prints the walkway beside the under-stair toilet as 'W4 +0.40' while A-09/A-12 print the walkway +0.45: kept as two levels, +0.40 with a lowered score, no value chosen over the other. A-18's '~2.45' floor-to-landing row agrees with S-12 (landing 3.05).

op04 dimension sweep batch 3 (PT-01..PT-10 pages 44-53, EE-01..EE-03 pages 54-56, F-01 page 57): none of these sheets prints a grid bubble, so nothing can be anchored to a line -- the PT-02 truss-layout rows (987 | 1377 ... | 986 mm along x; 60 .. 59 mm on each hip end) and the PT-03..PT-08 truss elevations (1055 | 10550 | 1055 mm) went to unassigned_dimensions. PT-01, EE-01 and F-01 are divider pages; EE-02/EE-03 (electrical plans 1:150) print no dimension row or level; PT-08's spec text and PT-10's connection details carry material sizes only. F-02 (blackboard) and F-03 (teacher's desk/chair) are furniture detail sheets with element-internal sizes only: skipped, not transcribed (op_fix step 2 'member-detail sheets ... listed as skipped').

Sweep status after 2026-10-23 (supersedes the older 'Sweep status' warning): every sheet the first run listed as not swept is now swept -- A-09 (completed), A-10..A-24, PT-01..PT-10, EE-01..EE-03, F-01 (F-02/F-03 skipped as furniture details). The confidence flag partial_dimension_sweep is removed.
